g.text: 1 Reciprocal vectors and zones

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Cubic: q = (h,k,l)/a. HCP internal coordinates: q = ((2h+k)/(√3 a),

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: k/a, l/c). ORT: q = (h/a,k/b,l/c).

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Integer reflections obey the internal zone law hu + kv + lw = 0.
